title: Pan-Seared Monkfish Pilaf
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring pan-seared monkfish served on top of a savory turkish pilaf.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season monkfish fillets with smoky paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add monkfish to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat the turkish pilaf according to package instructions.
Serve the pan-seared monkfish on top of the pilaf.
Squeeze lemon juice over the fish and pilaf.
Garnish with silky turkish spices, if desired.
